note: The champion recipe every Short follows (CLAUDE.md, the weekly loop). The improver updates it whenever a challenger is kept: the rule it adds or replaces gets `since` and `from: "cycle <n>"`, and the cycle goes into `changes`. Shown on the dashboard's Growth loop page.

rules.text: One surprising true money fact about a real, named person or business, from sourced facts; never an invented example
Two in three Shorts start from something the viewer buys, pays or watches and go behind it to the real business; a per-unit figure they can feel, never an annual total as the hook
The title and the hook name the subject and ask the question; the payoff's figure waits for the payoff (one figure in a title at most; no "You think X?", no "Watch this")
Three openings drafted; a fresh reviewer picks the strongest
The payoff is the story's most surprising figure; no reaction shots
Plain words: keeps, takes home, pays, owes; never revenue, Treasury, net worth, margin
The last line loops into the first frame; any question is a pick-one between two concrete choices, never a yes/no
The cast act a skit only when they are in the story; for an everyday topic a cast member is the viewer, doing the everyday act
One narrator for every Short, the voice at 1.4
Shot and build beats: the cast big, money as a thing, a camera that follows each action

The hook shows the real subject from frame 0: the person's freely licensed photo head or the company's logo as a die-cut sticker, big, named, with the hook figure beside it (never a copyrighted poster or a frame of the show)
Each Short's bed carries its own short tune (a pentatonic phrase in its key on its own instrument), heard in the pauses between lines and dropped before the payoff

changes.change: After the content research (every Short stopped at 150-1,190 views): everyday-thing topics, ask-then-answer openings, plain words, loop endings; the everyday-brands and per-unit-hook challengers were folded in
The real person's photo or the company's logo in the first frame became the default for every Short; cycle 1 closed before its verdict at the owner's word
Each Short's own tune in the pauses became the default (owner's sound note of 17 Nov; his 19 Nov rule: feedback goes straight away)
